cues.name: Warm Up
cues.notes: Doors. Everything on the ball, small and warm, nothing moving fast enough to look at.

cues.name: Idle
cues.notes: Room filling. The wave opens up and the heads stop moving together.

cues.name: Deep
cues.notes: Colour arrives. Spread to a half cycle so the sweep reads as a chase rather than a bar.

cues.name: Spiral
cues.notes: Still on the ball, but the specks start travelling.

cues.name: Cathedral
cues.notes: Up and out. The look everyone looks up for -- back to unison so the four columns read as one shape.

cues.name: Peak
cues.notes: Converge and diverge. Bigger than authored, because the room is full by now.

cues.name: Build
cues.notes: Vertical curtain at double speed. Passes through the ball twice a cycle, so the specks pulse on each pass.

cues.name: Drop
cues.notes: A CUT, not a fade. The one cue on this list where fade 0 is the right answer.

cues.name: Landing
cues.notes: Long way down. Back where it started, smaller and slower. The list stops here rather than wrapping.
